Interface JsonReader

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface JsonReader extends AutoCloseable
A pull reader over one JSON document, one token at a time. There is no tree: codecs ask for exactly the values they expect, and skip the rest.

Reading the wrong kind of value (a string where a number is) throws JsonException, as does malformed input. Every method may block reading the underlying stream, which on a virtual thread parks it instead of holding a carrier.

Not thread safe. close() returns the reader's buffers to its backend and doesn't close the underlying stream, which the caller owns.
